collection.description: A nursing mother is devastated after the death of her baby.

scene.text: A nursing mother is devastated after the death of her baby.

choices.label: Encourage a careful, compassionate approach suited to this situation.
Let the participants decide, respecting their independence.
Intervene, investigate, or seek help if the circumstances warrant it.

text_only.reason: the baby's death is the premise, already past; a baby is no villager (Q10: the mother is cast, the baby is text)

e1.text: A trusted relative stays beside her as she grieves.
